newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Aracruz started as neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Aracruz started as neutral.

text.p: -- Fonte Cindam investment bank said it started coverage of Brazilian pulp and paper firm Aracruz Celulose S.A. with a neutral rating.

-- The bank said Aracruz, whose Level 3 American Depositary Receipts (ADR) trade on the New York Stock Exchange, will show weak results this year, although better in the second half, due to a decline in world pulp prices.
-- "Some analysts are recommending a buy and projecting a 10 percent increase in profits, but we're being more conservative," said Fonte Cindam analyst Roberto Veirano.
-- The bank is projecting a net profit of $41 million this year, $113 million next year and $158 million in 1998. The firm earned $357 million in 1995.
-- The bank said its analysis takes into account a price hike announced on October 1 and an average price increase of 25 percent in 1997.

-- With the arrival of new partners, Aracruz's plans to enter the solid materials area has been postponed, while its planned investments to modernize and boost capacity are being maintained, the bank said.
-- Aracruz's Preferred B share was flat at 1.80 reais and its ADR was up 1/8 at 8-3/4 at 1445 local/1245 EDT on the Sao Paulo and New York exchanges, respectively.
